relationships.id: REL:'Main Data'[%Carrier Group ID] -> 'Carrier Groups'[%Carrier Group ID]
relationships.query: DEFINE VAR missing = EXCEPT(SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(ALLNOBLANKROW('Main Data'[%Carrier Group ID]), NOT ISBLANK('Main Data'[%Carrier Group ID])), "k", 'Main Data'[%Carrier Group ID]), SELECTCOLUMNS(ALLNOBLANKROW('Carrier Groups'[%Carrier Group ID]), "k", 'Carrier Groups'[%Carrier Group ID])) EVALUATE ROW("unmatched_keys", COUNTROWS(missing) + 0, "unmatched_rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Main Data'), REMOVEFILTERS(), TREATAS(missing, 'Main Data'[%Carrier Group ID])) + 0, "duplicate_keys", COUNTROWS(ALLNOBLANKROW('Carrier Groups')) - COUNTROWS(ALLNOBLANKROW('Carrier Groups'[%Carrier Group ID])))
